description: HP-34 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) code for the Kullu sub-division in Himachal Pradesh. It is administered by the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office and is responsible for the registration of non-commercial vehicles and the issuance of driving licenses in the Kullu valley area.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Dhalpur, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
